items.title: Stremio Claude on Android TV
items.text: The same app on Sony Bravia and every Android TV / Google TV, installed from FreeTV's Store. Code: github.com/PharmaJava/webos

items.title: Films and Series tabs, and a Top 10
items.text: Each with its categories: today's Top 10, popular, top rated, this year's, last year's and every genre.

items.title: Opened from FreeTV
items.text: A film or series picked on FreeTV's home opens here, on its own page.

items.title: The pointer when you want it
items.text: Move the remote, turn or press the wheel and it comes out. It stays until you press Back.

items.title: The community's improvements
items.text: Sharper pictures and backdrops, an Anime tab, every catalogue row, faster loading, and more.

items.title: More subtitles read right
items.text: Foreign-dialogue-only subtitles, Arabic and Central European files, and Hungarian.

items.title: No more closing mid-film
items.text: A fault in the torrent engine closed the app every few minutes while a film played. Fixed.

items.title: No TV screensaver over a film
items.text: The app now answers the TV, so its screensaver no longer covers what you watch.

items.title: Subtitles that stay in time
items.text: Two translations of one release no longer count as two opinions when lining subtitles up.

items.title: Back goes back
items.text: Back leaves the video straight away. The pointer hides on the arrows, on Back and when the hand stays still.

items.title: Completely renovated
items.text: Rebuilt as a native app. Fast to open, smooth to move.

items.title: The best stream, picked for you
items.text: Tested on your TV, one press to play.

items.title: Cast from your phone
items.text: Your TV shows up on your phone. Launch the app, play and control it directly. The Android app arrives soon.

items.title: People and reviews
items.text: The cast list, reviews and a spotlight of what's new.

items.title: Subtitles that just fit
items.text: One-press sync, styled as the film made them.

items.title: Picture and sound
items.text: Dolby Vision, DTS converted on the TV, USB for torrents.
